title: Xyriel Manabat, Juan Karlos Labajo win top acting honors at CinePanalo 2026

blocks.text: Xyriel Manabat and Juan Karlos Labajo took home the top acting honors at the 2026 CinePanalo Film Festival, with Manabat winning Panalong Aktres for “Stuck on You” and Labajo named Panalong Aktor for “Mono No Aware.” Manabat accepted her award during the festival’s awarding ceremony on Thursday night, Sept. 30, where she thanked the organizers for providing opportunities to filmmakers and artists. “Salamat po sa lahat ng bumubuo ng CinePanalo Film Festival.
